## Observed release blocker

[Daily Release run 37296452982, attempt 1](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/actions/runs/37296452982/job/111718707402) failed `Verify merged release` at 10:29:20 UTC on 5 October 2026.

The job checked out merged release commit [f2413324c99fc08764932a4593208308f0ec20a2](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/commit/f2413324c99fc08764932a4593208308f0ec20a2), after [PR #225](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/pull/225) merged the 2026.10.5 metadata at 10:28:15 UTC. Runtime: Node 22.23.3. The earlier release-check stage passed 532/532 tests; the post-merge coverage run passed 531/532 and exited 1.

The failing test is `pm extension command works when only node cli entrypoint is available`. The stack points to its `t.after` cleanup at [test/generator.test.ts:2873–2883](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/f2413324c99fc08764932a4593208308f0ec20a2/test/generator.test.ts#L2873-L2883):

```text
Error: ENOTEMPTY: directory not empty, rmdir '$TMPDIR/pm-changelog-node-cli-<random>/global-pm'
at TestContext.<anonymous> (.../test/generator.test.ts:2875:17)
at TestHook.runInAsyncScope (...)
```

That hook already uses `rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 20, retryDelay: 100 })`. A suggestion to add a basic retry would miss the observed state.

## Impact and publication truth

The [post-merge workflow](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/f2413324c99fc08764932a4593208308f0ec20a2/.github/workflows/release.yml#L644-L669) runs `npm ci` and `npm run release:check` before publication. Its failure left these four downstream steps skipped: npm publication, release tag, Bun installed-package verification and GitHub release creation.

At the 10:39 UTC registry check, [npm metadata](https://registry.npmjs.org/pm-changelog) still has latest 2026.10.4, gitHead `5de5ffe853d8d0bada163868b492c11da95321cf`, and no 2026.10.5 version. [Latest GitHub release](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/releases/tag/v2026.10.4) is also 2026.10.4. Main's 2026.10.5 manifest therefore does not establish a published release.

## Evidence limits

This is a directly observed hosted failure, not an independently reproduced local stress result. The log establishes a cleanup failure. Concurrent/background filesystem activity is a possible explanation; the process or writer and root cause have not been established. The metadata-only PR does not establish a causal runtime regression. No workflow retry, code change or release action was performed during this review.

## Acceptance

- Identify why the fixture directory remains non-empty despite the existing bounded cleanup retries, and make this fixture's process/resource lifecycle and teardown reliable
- Preserve the actual node-entrypoint/no-global-pm assertions and isolated PM roots; do not skip the case or silently swallow persistent cleanup failures
- Add targeted coverage for the identified teardown condition, including delayed activity if investigation establishes it, and demonstrate the full release check passes on the intended commit
- Preserve the post-merge fail-closed publication gate. Verify npm artifact/tag/Bun/GitHub-release outcomes separately when a release is later authorized

## Duplicate check and prior ownership

All 224 current GitHub issue/PR records, open and closed, and all 178 canonical PM item files at `f2413324` were checked. No active item owns this exact recurrence; open #224 concerns partial changelog input and is separate.

- [Closed pmc-70yk](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/f2413324c99fc08764932a4593208308f0ec20a2/.agents/pm/issues/pmc-70yk.toon) / [merged #70](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/pull/70) addressed historical ENOTEMPTY cleanup in the package-install fixture with retries. This report preserves that fix and records a current failure in the node-entrypoint fixture despite its existing retries.
- [Closed pmc-femy](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/f2413324c99fc08764932a4593208308f0ec20a2/.agents/pm/issues/pmc-femy.toon) / [merged #128](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/pull/128) owns node-entrypoint fixture isolation and assertions.
- [Certification pmc-38z4](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/f2413324c99fc08764932a4593208308f0ec20a2/.agents/pm/chores/pmc-38z4.toon) / [merged #221](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/pull/221) is related broad certification work. That change introduced this fixture's 20-retry teardown hook; it does not currently track this failure.

This is a recurrence report with newly observed release impact, retaining existing successful fixes and the fail-closed release policy.
